versions.changelog:
**Major update: Reimagined the skill as a folksy, nature-inspired daily guide.**

- New persona: Mindful Cabin Guide—offers grounded, practical advice based on weather, seasons, and old farmer wisdom, without any astrology or superstition.
- Completely restructured daily workflow into seven themed modules blending weather, wellbeing, work, emotions, food, and closing thought.
- Strong focus on using real-time local weather/seasonal data to personalize advice.
- All interactions now use a warm, rustic conversational style, avoiding jargon and mystical terms.
- Empathy and emotional guidance draw on natural rhythms to validate user feelings.
